entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Athabaskan peoples who migrated from Canada to the Southwest and became legendary guerrilla fighters. Geronimo's band of 38 warriors evaded 5,000 US troops for over a year. Their survival skills in harsh desert terrain were unmatched.
